title: Can I SURVIVE Chess960?
summary: Plain Chess960 (Fischer Random / Freestyle) games on chess.com vs ~1620-1800 rated humans; goal is to win 3 games, and he wins all three.
rules: Standard Chess960: back-rank pieces shuffled into one of 960 positions (bishops on opposite colours, king between rooks), mirrored for both sides.
Chess960 castling is allowed (narrator castles queenside in game 1).
setup: Random Chess960 back rank, same for both sides; pawns standard.
events: Back-rank shuffle reveal animation at game start
current_impl_issues: Explain text says 'no castling' - Chess960 has castling (king and rook land on standard castled squares). Otherwise correct base mode.
evidence: Transcript 0:01 'back rank pieces are scrambled for a total of 960 different possible starting positions... win three games'; 0:38 'I think we're definitely castling queen side'; game 2 1800-rated, game 3 1770. Frames: green board, shuffled back rank, MVoigt (1623).
